scope: Finite registered task/ecology/resource envelopes. The contract specifies what must be declared before protected outcomes; it does not assert a morphology phase law or empirical capability result.
assumptions: all finite alphabets, kernels, costs, budgets and splits used by a confirmatory claim are frozen before protected scoring
surface labels and remint identity are semantically inert and unavailable to the evaluated machine unless explicitly part of the task
resource coordinates are nonnegative and hard feasibility is evaluated componentwise before any scalar price comparison
other adaptive agents are environment participants with declared information/action/adaptation interfaces, not hidden fixed-noise processes
a remint changes only declared nominal encodings and preserves the registered semantic object up to the stated bijections
evidence_class: P1 formal specification plus executable finite structural/remint witnesses
strongest_parent: POMDP/controlled stochastic process for observation-action dynamics; Markov/stochastic games and Dec-POMDPs for multiple adaptive agents/local information; Blackwell decision comparison for information acquisition; SCM/do semantics for interventions. GMI-specific residual is prospective registration, resource/verifier accounting, protected splits and remint anti-leakage.
falsifier: Any A2 coordinate is absent or post-hoc; an adaptive participant is omitted from the environment object; hard budgets and prices are conflated; verification latency/loss or information-acquisition cost is uncharged; a protected split leaks; or a declared remint fails semantic isomorphism while still being treated as equivalent.
ecology_object: E = (agents, observations, actions_interventions, feedback_verifier, task_horizon, drift, recurrence_reuse, noise_partial_observability, structure, social_topology, embodiment, resources, verification_economics, information_acquisition, protected_split, remint_equivalence)

adaptive_agents.rule: Every participant whose policy/state update can depend on interaction history is represented explicitly. Fixed opponents may be marked nonadaptive; adaptive opponents/partners may not be collapsed into stationary noise without changing the ecology claim.

observation_structure.rule: Declare what each agent can observe and when. Partial observation is represented by a many-to-one or stochastic observation channel, not by prose.

action_intervention_structure.rule: Ordinary actions and causal interventions are distinct registered channels when both exist. An intervention declares what mechanism is externally set and what other mechanisms remain invariant.

feedback_verifier_structure.rule: Training/development feedback and final verification authority are distinct objects even when implemented by the same checker.

task_distribution_horizon.rule: The distribution/schedule and horizons are frozen; a finite full-domain enumeration is named as such rather than called 'large'.

drift_regime_change.rule: Stationarity is an explicit zero-drift special case. Drift names which semantics, frequencies, prices or verifier conditions change.

recurrence_reuse.rule: Repeated opportunities are registered independently of task labels so amortization laws cannot be fitted after seeing reuse benefits.

noise_partial_observability.rule: Deterministic/full-observation cases are zero-noise/full-access specializations. Noise and hidden state are not merged into one scalar.

compositional_symmetry_relational_struct.rule: Only prospectively declared structure may justify sharing, equivariance, compositional reuse or relational operators.

social_topology.rule: For multiple agents, who can affect/observe/message whom is part of the ecology. A complete graph is a declared special case, not an implicit default.

embodiment_sensor_actuator.rule: If embodiment is irrelevant, use explicit NONE/UNCONSTRAINED values. Otherwise sensing and actuation constraints are charged environment coordinates.

resource_prices_hard_budgets.rule: Feasibility is componentwise against hard budgets. Prices are a separate prospectively frozen nonnegative scalarization and never repair an infeasible point.

verification_latency_cost_false_adoption.rule: Accuracy alone is insufficient: latency, verification burden and asymmetric adoption/rejection losses are separately registered.

information_acquisition_cost.rule: Observations that require an active probe/query are not free observations. Acquisition cost and delay are charged before value-of-information claims.

protected_train_development_heldout_spli.rule: Held-out tasks/remints/outcomes are inaccessible to construction, search and coordinate choice before the freeze point.

ecology_equivalence_remint.rule: E and E' are remint-equivalent only under bijections of nominal encodings that preserve transition/observation laws, obligations, verifier semantics, costs/budgets, topology, embodiment and split membership. Remint identity is hidden by default.

anti_leakage.exception_rule: A forbidden field may be made visible only when the task explicitly requires it; then it is no longer usable as protected evidence for invariance/remint claims.
